items.text: inzwai izvi, imi ndudzi dziri kure;
kubva pakuzvarwa kwangu akataura zita rangu.
ndapedza simba rangu pane zvisina maturo uye pasina.
Nyamba zvakandifanira ini zviri muruoko rwaJehovha,
uye mubayiro wangu uri kuna Mwari."
iye akandiumba ndiri muchizvaro kuti ndive muranda wake,
uye Mwari wangu ndiye anga ari simba rangu,
"Chinhu chiduku kwazvo kuti iwe uve muranda wangu,
kuti uuyise ruponeso rwangu kumigumo yenyika."
kuna iye akanga azvidzwa uye akasemwa norudzi,
uye vachawana mafuro pazvikomo zvose zvisina zvibereko.
havangabayiwi nokupisa kwegwenga, kana nokupisa kwezuva.
Ndichashandura makomo angu ose kuti ave migwagwa,
uye achava netsitsi navanhu vake vanotambudzika.
"Ko, mai vangakanganwa mucheche anonwa ari pachipfuva chavo,
uye vangasanzwira tsitsi mwana wavakazvara here?
madziro ako anogara ari mberi kwangu.
Simudza meso ako utarise kwose kwose;
vanakomana vako vose vanoungana vachiuya kwauri.
uye nyika yako yakasiyiwa yava dongo,
"Tarira ndichasimudza ruoko rwangu kune veDzimwe Ndudzi,
vachauya navanakomana vako vari mumaoko avo,
uye vachatakura vanasikana vako pamapfudzi avo.
uye vanamambokadzi vavo vachava vanamai vanokurerai.
kana vatapwa vanganunurwa kubva kune anotyisa here?
Ndichaita kuti vamanikidzi vako vadye nyama yavo;
Ipapo vanhu vose vachaziva kuti ini Jehovha,
